knowledge:
- key_parameters: disFamily=Specifies the sub-distribution family of the mixture model ("norm" for Normal, "lnorm" for Log-Normal, or "weibull" for Weibull) ;; nComp=The order (number of components) of the FMRs model ;; penFamily=The penalty type used for variable selection ("adplasso", "lasso", "mcp", "scad", "sica", or "hard") ;; lambPen=Tuning parameters for the penalty components, typically extracted from the slot of an fmrs.tunsel object ;; lambRidge=Tuning parameter for ridge penalty in fmrs.mle (set to non-zero to perform ridge regression)
- alternatives: Common tuning parameter selection (using BIC search over an interval) vs. Component-wise tuning parameter selection (using fmrs.tunsel). Component-wise is preferred for component-specific sparsity but is still under theoretical study.
- when_to_use: When performing parameter estimation and variable selection for Finite Mixture of Regression (FMR) models or Finite Mixture of Accelerated Failure Time (AFT) models, especially with censored survival data.
- pitfalls: Mixture models are highly sensitive to initial values. It is critical to provide reasonable initial values (initCoeff, initDispersion, initmixProp) to fmrs.mle, and then use the resulting MLE estimates as initial values for fmrs.tunsel and fmrs.varsel. Component-wise tuning parameter selection via fmrs.tunsel is still under theoretical study and is not mathematically proven to yield optimal values in all general cases.

workflows.name: fmrs_mle_and_variable_selection
workflows.intent: Fit a finite mixture of regression/AFT model, select optimal tuning parameters, and perform sparse variable selection.
workflows.stages: 1. Fit the initial FMR/AFT model using Maximum Likelihood Estimation with fmrs.mle ;; 2. Select component-wise tuning parameters using fmrs.tunsel with MLE estimates as initial values ;; 3. Perform sparse variable selection using fmrs.varsel with the selected tuning parameters ;; 4. Extract the selected active set of covariates using slot(..., "selectedset")
workflows.code:
dat <- fmrs.gendata(nObs = nObs, nComp = nComp, nCov = nCov,
                     coeff = c(coeff1, coeff2), dispersion = dispersion,
                     mixProp = mixProp, rho = rho, umax = umax,
                     disFamily = "lnorm")

res.mle <- fmrs.mle(y = dat$y, x = dat$x, delta = dat$delta,
                   nComp = nComp, disFamily = "lnorm",
                   initCoeff = rnorm(nComp*nCov+nComp),
                   initDispersion = rep(1, nComp),
                   initmixProp = rep(1/nComp, nComp))
summary(res.mle)

res.lam <- fmrs.tunsel(y = dat$y, x = dat$x, delta = dat$delta,
                      nComp = nComp, disFamily = "lnorm",
                      initCoeff = c(coefficients(res.mle)),
                      initDispersion = dispersion(res.mle),
                      initmixProp = mixProp(res.mle),
                      penFamily = "adplasso")
summary(res.lam)

res.var <- fmrs.varsel(y = dat$y, x = dat$x, delta = dat$delta,
                      nComp = ncomp(res.mle), disFamily = "lnorm",
                      initCoeff=c(coefficients(res.mle)),
                      initDispersion = dispersion(res.mle),
                      initmixProp = mixProp(res.mle),
                      penFamily = "adplasso",
                      lambPen = slot(res.lam, "lambPen"))
summary(res.var)

slot(res.var, "selectedset")
